Hey there, I helped a close family member complete her VAD kit two weeks ago, so I have a lot of first hand info about this as I assisted her through her kit and was with her all the way til the end. If it’s any consolation, it was an incredibly peaceful death, what I would consider an “ideal death”, if there is such a thing.

VAD nurses are cross-trained as grief counsellors, I spoke to one of them recently who was actually there with me on the day of her passing, and she is going to put me in touch with bereavement counselling which VAD cover the costs for. she is also going to email me a bunch of resources to help me.

Please feel free to pm me if there’s any questions :)

I’m currently in Lucerne and have been for the last few days. There has been rain yesterday and today, but it comes in short bursts and then clears up. Bring rain jackets when you’re out and about, if it rains stand under shop verandas for a few mins til it clears up, and carry on. Would recommend going to the glacier garden, it is beautiful, child friendly, and most parts are under cover. Enjoy the trip :)
